title: Moltbook Observer - Stage 1 to Stage 3: Execution Protocol and Live Run
summary: Define AND execute a reproducible protocol that results in the Calamum Moltbook observer running live (Stages 1-3 only) and producing real, obfuscated telemetry. This job includes methodology + procedural documentation, plus the documented Stage 1-3 live run(s) under the hardened lane. Stage 4 remains deferred unless separately authorized and explicitly recorded.

status_update.next_action: Remediate drift in the Stage 1-3 execution protocol paperwork (Job 0006 + monitoring widget plan): align JSON<->MD, remove placeholders, add explicit stop-conditions and a names-only control-event schema/evidence sink, then re-run gates and tests.

current_state: Academic research requires explicit methodology and document-planned actions.
Stage 1-3 live execution must be repeatable and produce obfuscated outputs only.
Stage 4 must remain out of scope unless separately authorized.
root_cause: The project needs a single authoritative execution protocol that defines scope boundaries and evidence outputs.
impact: Without a single authoritative execution protocol, the observer could accidentally exceed scope or violate governance rails.
Academic reproducibility degrades without a method + provenance spec and an evidence mapping.
problem.architecture: Stages 1-3 only, read-only, hostile-content posture. All execution is mediated by the CodeSentinel job/gate workflow and produces names-only, obfuscated structured telemetry. Stage 4 (posting/active magnet) remains out-of-scope unless separately authorized.
implementation_steps: Create the Stage 1-3 Execution Protocol document (JSON authoritative + MD view) with: threat model, guardrails, methodology, and evidence matrix.
Record scope boundary: Stage 1-3 may be executed live (read-only); Stage 4 remains deferred unless separately authorized and explicitly recorded.
Define deterministic, stepwise procedures for Stage 1 (observe/sample), Stage 2 (hardening verification), Stage 3 (passive canary metrics-only) without retrieving or storing raw DM bodies.
Define required gates and evidence outputs for each procedure (PREFLIGHT/BOD/PRE_JOB/POST_JOB/EOD), aligned to ops-awareness.
Define a minimal 'stop conditions' list (fail-closed): redirect seen, non-www host, non-JSON content-type, unexpected endpoints, sentinel kill triggers.
Execute the documented Stage 1-3 procedure(s) and confirm real obfuscated JSONL outputs are produced.
Reconcile the Stage 4 strategy document with this scope boundary and record an explicit decision (remain deferred unless separately authorized).

requirements: Academic reproducibility: methodology, provenance chain, and procedural steps must be explicit and repeatable.
Only document-planned actions are permitted; execution must match the written protocol exactly.
Stage scope limited to 1-3; Stage 4 deferred and must not be activated by default.
Host isolation: treat Moltbook as hostile; no host installation required; minimize attack surface.
No secrets, tokens, private identifiers, or raw content in docs or logs.
acceptance_criteria: A Stage 1-3 Execution Protocol document exists (JSON authoritative + MD view) under project planning.
Protocol includes guardrails (www-only, no redirects, GET-only allowlist), threat model, and stop conditions.
Protocol includes an evidence matrix mapping each step to expected artifacts/paths.
Stage 1 live run produces obfuscated JSONL telemetry (real data; no raw text) in the designated Calamum logs path.
Stage 3 canary metrics collection (if executed) produces metrics-only logs (no DM bodies) in the designated Calamum logs path.
Protocol explicitly documents Stage 4 deferral and the condition for re-activation (explicit governance exception + human signoff).

preflight: Confirm ops-awareness + policy snapshot are current and referenced.
Confirm redaction palette and names-only rule.
steps: Produce protocol + evidence mapping (JSON authoritative + MD view).
Execute the documented Stage 1-3 live run(s) under the hardened lane and confirm real obfuscated telemetry outputs.

rollout.rollback_plan: Archive-first rollback: stop the observer/container, preserve produced logs for provenance, and retire any superseded artifacts by moving them to quarantine_legacy_archive/ (never delete).
verification: Manual review: confirm no secrets/identifiers and that Stage 4 is explicitly deferred.
Consistency check: JSON authoritative and MD view agree on steps, guardrails, and evidence paths.

smoke_tests: Stage 1-3 live run produces obfuscated JSONL telemetry; no raw content

security: Fail-closed guardrails; strict endpoint/host allowlists; treat feed as hostile input.
No raw content export; obfuscation-only telemetry.
No secrets in repo; env-var only; names-only docs.
efficiency: Single authoritative protocol reduces drift and rework; avoids repeated ad-hoc decisions.
awareness: Evidence matrix + gate mapping ensures every action has auditable provenance.
Explicit Stage boundary definitions prevent scope creep.
minimalism: Prefer existing VAULT templates and existing Calamum job artifacts; add only the minimum new protocol needed.
